I had a very disappointing experience with Neeta Travels due to the unprofessional behavior of the driver they assigned us - Vasim Akbar Sharif. He was extremely lazy, dishonest, and completely ruined our sightseeing plans.

Throughout the day, he kept lying to us, saying places like the museum, Hanging Garden, and even the ferry to Elephanta Caves were "closed",  just to avoid taking us there. It became very clear that he simply didn’t want to do his job properly and was looking for excuses to cut the trip short.

featured_reviews.name: Arnav Sinha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I needed an SUV for a four-day trip with my parents to Bhimashankar and Lonavala. Unfamiliar with any reliable cab service in Mumbai, I contacted Imran Bhai simply based on the Google reviews. Even though I was initially unsure, it turned out to be a great decision in hindsight. He was patient with my requests before the trip and gave a quick and reasonable quote. The Ertiga we got was spotless, probably brand new, and worked smoothly throughout the trip. Wasim, who drove us over the trip, was super-polite and a good driver. Despite our resort in Bhimashankar not having great facilities for drivers, he never complained.
On the whole, this was a great trip, and I am thankful to Imran Bhai and Wasim for ensuring we faced no issues on the travel front. I would highly recommend Neeta Travels to anyone needing cab services in and around Mumbai. And we are surely going to go back to him the next time we need to visit the city.

featured_reviews.name: Shalini Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the Siddhivinayak Temple in Mumbai, and it was an unforgettable experience! This iconic Hindu temple is dedicated to Lord Ganesha and is a must-visit destination for any devotee or traveler.
The temple is one of the most revered and popular Ganesh temples in India, attracting millions of devotees every year.
The temple's stunning architecture, with its intricate carvings and beautiful idol of Lord Ganesha, left me in awe.
The temple's vibrant atmosphere, filled with the sounds of chanting and the scent of incense sticks, created a truly spiritual experience.
Best Time to Visit Early morning or late evening hours are ideal to avoid crowds.
Modest clothing is recommended, and devotees are expected to dress in traditional attire. Western clothes are banned 🚫
The temple offers various types of darshan, including regular darshan and special darshan, which can be booked in advance.
The Siddhivinayak Temple is a must-visit destination for anyone traveling to Mumbai. The temple's spiritual significance, stunning architecture, and vibrant atmosphere make it an unforgettable experience. Plan your visit wisely, and you'll have a wonderful time!
